RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the November 28, 2005/Agrahayana 7, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Culture; Development of North Eastern Region; Heavy Industries
and Public Enterprises; Human Resource Development; Information and
Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines; Social Justice and Empowerment;
Tribal Affairs; Urban Employment and Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions — 20
Amendments to Wakf Act
*61. MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI : Will the Minister of
SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether any suggestions have been
received for amendments to the Wakf Act,
1995;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action being taken in the matter?
Merger of Mid-Day Meal programme
with S.S.A.
*62. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY :
Will the Minister of  HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have implemented Mid-Day Meal
programme in the schools in various States;
and
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government propose to merge Mid-Day
Meal programme with Sarva Shiksha
Abhiyan?
Puppet shows
*63. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA :
Will the Minister of  CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government had held any
puppet shows for the children on the
occasion of the International Puppetry Day
recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the amount incurred; and
(d) the steps being taken by
Government to increase the awareness
about the puppet shows among kids?
Elementary education and SSA in NE
States
*64. DR. KARAN SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to strengthen the feedback gathering system
on the progress of elementary education

20
and Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA) in North-
Eastern States;
(b) whether under the existing funding
arrangement for elementary education and
Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan, the Union and State
Governments, contribution ratio has been
75 and 25 per cent respectively;
(c) whether during the last two years
some degree of stability was brought in NE
States; and
(d) if so, what steps Government
propose to achieve progress of elementary
education and SSA in these States?
Accountability of foreign channel
operators
*65. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
Will the Minister of  INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Amended Cable TV
Network Rules, 1994 make foreign channel
operators (Discovery, Ten Sports, Star
Network and HBO) more accountable, as
now they will have to register themselves
by depositing Rs. 1.5 crore and also
nominating an Indian for telecasting their
programmes in the country;
(b) if so, whether a special mechanism
has been evolved for this purpose; and
(c) if so, whether the discrepancies, if
any, detected in their programmes would
be taken care of?
Illegal mining
†*66.  SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
  SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of  MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether illegal mining is being carried
out in various parts of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the financial loss suffered as a result
thereof during the last three years;
(d) the impact of illegal mining activities
on the environment; and
(e) the steps taken/to be taken by
Government to deal with such illegal
activities?
Abolition of quota and reservation in
private institutions
*67. SHRI MANOJ
BHATTACHARYA:
SHRI UDAY PRATAP SINGH:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether  the Supreme Court of India
has recently ruled that Government,
requirement that the private institutions
which do not receive any State aid, should
also follow Government's policy on
reservation of seats for the backward
classes, is a serious encroachment on the
rights and autonomy of these institutions;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) Government's reaction thereto and
the steps, if any, proposed in this regard;
(d) whether Government have
constituted any committee for monitoring
the fee-structure in the private institutes;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof ?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

21
Nude serials on Doordarshan
*68. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:  Will
the Minister of  INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that rape cases
take place only due to broadcast of "Nude
Serials" on Doordarshan;
(b) if so, the details of such serials;
(c) the steps being taken/proposed to
be taken to put a ban on broadcast of such
serials; and
(d) by when such directions are
expected to be issued?

SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:

cognizance of the foreign universities and
educational institutions coming to India to
attract Indian students;

and Public Enterprises; Human Resource Development; Information and

Total number of questions —140
Construction of a "Ghat" on the bank
of Yamuna
440. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to construct a "Ghat" on the bank of River
Yamuna, on the pattern of "Har Ki Pauri
Ghat" at Hardwar (Uttaranchal) to celebrate
"Chhat Festival" in Delhi;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when it is expected to be
constructed and other facilities to be
provided for devotees?
Construction of Gurdwara in Puri
441. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a hi-tech
revolving Gurdwara, the first of its kind in
the country, would be constructed near the
sea beach in Puri, Orissa, to mark the visit
of Guru Nanak, the first Guru of Sikhs, to
this holy city in 1506;
(b) whether this Gurdwara has already
started functioning on a temporary basis;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Heritage sites in NER
442. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that nine national
sites in the North Eastern Region (NER)
are proposed to be recommended as World
heritage sites;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government are aware that
Orissa is one of the historical heritage
centres of the country which are the most
sought after religious hubs in the World;
(d) if so, whether there is a proposal to
recommend any of such centre as World
heritage; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?

102
Remains of cities near Surat
†443. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH: Will
the Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Archaeo-
logical Survey of India has recently found
one thousand year old remains of cities and
villages near Surat in Gujarat; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Valley of Flowers in Uttaranchal
444. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the World
famous Valley of Flowers in the Uttaranchal
Himalayas has been declared a natural
World heritage site by UNESCO; and
(b) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to conserve this site?
Corporate participation for
conservation of monuments
445. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Archaeological Survey of India, the sole
custodian of the national monuments, has
decided to allow corporate participation in
its conservation efforts;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
initial corporate participation would be for
conservation of 5000 monuments under the
ASI's direct protection; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Munshi Premchand Memorial
Research and Study Centre
446. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to set up a Munshi Premchand Memorial
Research and Study Centre at his native
village in UP;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
estimated cost thereof;
(c) whether such memorials are
proposed to be set up for the other great
poets and authors of Hindi and regional
languages;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Documentation of unprotected
manuscripts of Karnataka
447. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
CULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government of
Karnataka has requested for financial
assistance for documentation of
unprotected manuscripts scattered all over
the State; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?
Tomb of Bahadur Shah Zafar
448. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
approached the Government of Myanmar
to bring the tomb of the Last Emperor of
India Bahadur Shah Zafar to the country;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

103
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
it is expected to be brought to Delhi; and
(c) the location selected to set up the
Tomb of that Emperor?
